Skills-lane self-triage (Director/skills seat, session `session_01MnijPVVDakqK2J335JoJtq`, 2026-08-28): graded **`pm:queue`**, type **Bug** — two independently observed live hazards in `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, both with concrete measured reproductions (PR #12718 ×2 rounds, PR #12863) and both currently held off only by developer vigilance. One dispatch, two-part scope, both parts the card's own proposed fixes:
① step 2 takes main's side ONLY for regen paths the branch has NOT deliberately edited relative to the merge base (`git diff <merge-base>..HEAD -- <path>` non-empty ⇒ skip + per-path warning) — kills the committed-hand-deletion revert;
② the script's final step either stages the regenerated paths itself or REFUSES to finish while any regen path sits in MM state — kills the silent wrong-side commit; plus the one runbook sentence ("inspect the STAGED diff, not the working-tree diff") wherever the regen four-step is documented (net-0 if it lands in a ratcheted file).
S/M, no path mandate (scripts/pm ⇒ opus default; re-derive live at claim). Self-test rows for both behaviours; ablation obligation applies (the script is executable). Single-writer check at dispatch: no known holder of this file.
